claims.text: Reddit users discuss a wide variety of topics including climate change, abortion, world news, relationship advice, and artificial intelligence.
Subreddits oriented around politics and religion tend to exhibit higher levels of dogmatism, while those focused on hobbies show lower levels.
Specific subreddits like DebateAChristian and ukpolitics are associated with high dogmatism, while photography and homebrewing are linked to lower dogmatism.
